subject.title: feat(gateway): session dashboard domain — board RPCs, ticketed widgets, dashboard tool, per-agent persistence

question: Should the initial public board API support `mcp-app` widgets, and if so which authorized client reconstruction/rendering contract is the permanent gateway boundary?
rationale: The branch already exposes `mcp-app` as a public board content kind, but no current response contains a usable authorized descriptor or render target. Selecting that contract changes the long-lived gateway and UI compatibility surface.

options.title: Narrow the first board API to HTML widgets
options.body: Remove or defer `mcp-app` from the public board contract until a separately reviewed renderer boundary exists.

options.title: Define the MCP-app boundary now
options.body: Add an authorized descriptor or ticketed reconstruction contract, implement the client renderer, and cover both grant and upgrade behavior before merge.

recommendation.title: Narrow the first board API to HTML widgets
recommendation.body: Remove or defer `mcp-app` from the public board contract until a separately reviewed renderer boundary exists.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor owns both the proposed gateway domain and the merged board-view foundation that must consume the resulting contract.
